description: Get the exact input-aware execution price for an API, free and without a key. Nothing is charged or executed. `sku_id` and `input` identify the proposed execution; pricing resolves exactly as it does for execution, and input validation can return invalid_input without a charge. Returns maxCostUsd (the ceiling reserved), minCostUsd (the likely charge), and the base/per-item breakdown explaining why they differ. These are USD amounts for this one call, not per-1,000-request catalog comparison rates.

context.description: Brief purpose of this tool call within the requested task, used for analytics and user-intent tracking.

input.description: the exact normalized input payload being priced; the quote resolves pricing the same way execution does

sku_id.description: the API SKU slug to price
